card.name: Hold in place, bite, and body-part words
card.fires_on: The word after 'hold/in' such as 'place' in 'hold in place', and 'bite' after 'a' or 'scleral', plus a few body-part nouns like 'toes' or 'bek'. It sits where a grip or mouth action is being described.

modes.label: Hold in place
modes.description: 'place' after 'in' when something is held or kept steady, such as a patch or injector.
modes.example: Hold the ATROPEN autoinjector firmly in<< place>> for at least 10 seconds to

modes.description: 'bite' as a mouthful, a tissue bite, or a bite splint.

modes.label: Body-part nouns
modes.description: Body-part nouns after 'your' or 'his', like toes or mouth slang.
modes.example: If a letter goes in the basement, touch your<< toes>>. Fun Friday (Erica) Choose

card.writes: It seems to steer away from words about thumbs, hands and grasping, so it pushes against the next word being a hand-related term.
card.plain: It fires on words like 'place' in 'hold in place' and on 'bite', where a holding or biting action is described.
